plans.title: Visuals in the chat
plans.goal: Agent sessions, build sessions especially, should show rich visuals in the chat: flow diagrams and maps of the parts a change touches, drawn with our own design system.
plans.brief:
Agent sessions, build sessions especially, show rich visuals in the chat: flow diagrams and maps of the parts a change touches, drawn with the design system’s own components.

The agent never writes HTML into the chat. A visual is a fenced block in a small, versioned vocabulary that Prelude parses, checks and renders with a design-system partial.
